2021 - The rise of Shiba Inu

Factors:
- Community (aka SHIB Army)
- FOMO (the next Dogecoin?)
- Half coin supply sent to Vitalik
- Utility

The SHIB Army was relentless and the driving force for many exchange listings.

Add a bull run in there, SHIB mooned.

Shiba Inu Origin

SHIB was created in 2020 and dubbed as "The Dogecoin killer."

It mixed meme culture and created utility with its own ecosystem.

I missed out on SHIB's launch, due to my inability of using Uniswap at the time.

Wounded.

2020 - The rise of Dogecoin

Factors:
- Community
- FOMO
- The timing of COVID
- Elon Musk endorsement
- Tesla accepting it as a form of payment

All of this combined exploded it into the DOGE we know today.

Dogecoin Origin

This still hurts, I once held millions!

Anyways, DOGE was created in 2013.

It is the first meme coin and also the first "dog coin."

Only a few realize this, but it's the second most mined coin after Bitcoin.
